items.summary: No new site-factory request is admitted this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, and launch evidence remains incomplete for scaffold candidates. Retain a small deferred pipeline of complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net as planning context only. The strongest candidate is complicated.work because it has the highest site-factory score and an existing bounded inspection; its next step, after one delivery slot is released, is to complete and verify one launch-readiness artifact covering the site brief, reusable template, content seed, SEO baseline, analytics/affiliate readiness, compliance checklist, owner assignment, security review, measurement plan, and rollback/launch gate. No preview publication, deployment, domain change, spending, dependency, credential, or telemetry change is authorized.
